short_description: Evidence-first workflows for reliable agent state, execution verification, and final-state audit.
long_description: RUMBO Agent Reliability helps recover canonical workflow state, reconcile conflicting evidence, keep execution within authority, verify observed effects, and audit final state before accepting completion claims.
starter_prompts: Recover the canonical state of this workflow before continuing.
Reconcile these conflicting execution receipts and tell me what is actually proven.
Audit this agent run and separate intended actions from verified effects.
